## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman characterized by a distinct lack of curves and numerous angles. She has sallow cheeks, hard work-worn hands, and dark hair that has grown grayer over time, which she wears twisted up into a hard little knot in the back.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Personality

Marilla Cuthbert is a sensible, self-contained, and practical woman who disdains imaginative notions, preferring to maintain neatness and apple-pie order. Driven by a rigid conscience and a stern devotion to duty, she aims to drill [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into a tranquil uniformity of disposition. She is strict, critical, and fond of attaching morals to her remarks to children, while also refusing on principle to criticize ministers. Though she can be inexorable, unsympathetic, and slightly grim or sarcastic—especially when suffering from headaches—she is also noted for having mellowed. Additionally, she is cautious and deliberate in her decision-making, deeply stoic about concealing excitement, and celebrated for her skill in making three-year-old homemade currant wine.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert grew up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), having lived there for sixty years after being raised under traditional childhood discipline. In her youth, she quarreled with John Blythe and refused to forgive him when he asked, a decision she later recounted to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after adopting her. When Marilla and her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, a mix-up resulted in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead. Though initially shocked and determined to send the girl back, Marilla took pity on [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after hearing of her hard childhood during a drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). Deciding to let her stay, Marilla resolved to raise and educate [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) properly. Over time, Marilla grew deeply affectionate toward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), caring for her through various childhood misadventures, such as when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly dyed her hair green and Marilla had to cut it off. When [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died suddenly of a heart attack following a bank failure, Marilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforted each other in their shared grief. Shortly after, an oculist informed Marilla that she faced total blindness if she did not give up heavy eye work, threatening her ability to keep [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). To prevent this, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forfeited her college scholarship to stay home, teach locally, and care for Marilla. Following the death of [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Marilla invited the widowed [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a living arrangement that ultimately freed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her local teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Quotes

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

> "She’ll have her meals regular, and I’ll carry them up to her myself. But she’ll stay up there until she’s willing to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and that’s final, Matthew."

> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P4](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0004)

> "and I can’t prevent her, for her father aids and abets her. She’s always poring over a book. I’m glad she has the prospect of a playmate—perhaps it will take her more out-of-doors."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla acts as an adoptive mother and dear friend to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), taking her in after an initial mix-up when she expected a boy to help on the farm. Though initially shocked and inclined to send [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back due to her lack of formal religious training and fiery temper, Marilla chooses to keep her after seeing her distress at another potential home and resolves to raise her properly. Over time, Marilla grows deeply affectionate toward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), guiding her through mistakes, comforting her during moments of grief, and allowing her to make [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) her permanent home.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla serves as the guardian of [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), actively disciplining and commanding him after taking him and his twin sister into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) frequently causes trouble through misbehavior—such as hiding a toad in Marilla's bed and locking his sister in a toolhouse—Marilla works alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to guide him, developing a fond affection for the boy despite his constant mischief.
